violations.explanation: Liking is only possible via a double-tap gesture on the photo, with no visible like button. While a custom semantics action is provided for screen reader users, users of keyboard, switch access or those with motor impairments who cannot perform double-taps have no discoverable, focusable control to toggle the like state.

The liked/unliked state is not exposed as a semantic property (e.g. toggled/selected or value); it is only implied by the custom action label. Screen reader users are not clearly informed whether the post is currently liked.
When the like state is toggled, the change in like count is not announced (no liveRegion or announcement), so assistive technology users receive no feedback that the action succeeded.
